sources.title: OPS-SAT benchmark for anomaly detection in satellite telemetry
sources.split_policy: Reproduce supplied official split exactly; preserve raw-fragment and engineered-feature tasks as separate subjects

Published article was corrected; verify the corrected record before baseline reproduction
Segment-level labels do not automatically justify time-based false-alarm rates
sources.claim_ceiling: Segment classification performance on the exact admitted OPSSAT-AD version and split only

sources.title: NASA SMAP/MSL telemetry used by existing legacy example
sources.split_policy: Preserve existing historical experiment and document its original split/preprocessing; do not make it the sole primary benchmark

Historical metric values are not directly comparable to the new sources without split and metric alignment
